nodes.name: Publish after layout
nodes.description: Each resize request shall publish exactly one ViewportChanged event after updating the UI layout.
constraints: Exactly one event per request, even if dimensions repeat.

metadata.verification: Nominal, repeated, and event consistency tests

nodes.name: Isolate future graphics backend
nodes.description: Future graphics API calls shall be confined to a platform backend boundary. No backend is implemented in this fixture.

nodes.name: Bound cache storage
nodes.description: The asset cache shall hold at most four unique resource IDs and evict the oldest insertion on overflow.

nodes.name: Keep resized state consistent
nodes.description: Every resize request shall normalize each dimension to the inclusive range 1..8192 using the shared geometry policy. The viewport, UI root bounds, and published size shall agree.
constraints: No duplicated clamping constants or independent normalization policy.
Preserve the single-threaded synchronous event order.
